description: Windows BitTorrent client with magnet links, torrent queues, peers, and a system-tray mode

script: if (-not $winget) { throw 'Wintor is distributed through Microsoft Store. Install App Installer (winget) before installing this Scoop manifest.' }
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -and -not (Get-AppxPackage -Name $packageName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { throw "Microsoft Store installation of Wintor failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE." }

notes: Wintor is officially distributed as a Microsoft Store app (Product ID 9P7P2DH9P4XN); this manifest installs the current-user Store package through winget and removes that package on Scoop uninstall.
Requires App Installer with winget and an available msstore source. Microsoft Store manages subsequent application updates.
This is a Nonportable MSIX/Store installation, not a portable GitHub release.
